sections.kicker: Prepared for Essence Catering by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Essence has an idea nobody else in catering owns. The site says it once and moves on.
sections.keep: The phrase "Responsible gastronomy." It is a real stance in a category that mostly sells menus.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.what: Your strongest idea is two words with no explanation.
pins.why: This is why people do not get it fast: responsible could mean local, low waste or ethical, and the site never says which.
pins.how: Say in one plain sentence what responsible means at Essence.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: Clients book on price because the reason to pay more stays vague.

pins.quote: quality catering for all of your events
pins.what: The second half of the line could belong to any caterer.
pins.why: Serving every kind of event tells planners you are not the specialist for theirs.
pins.how: Name the events you do best and let the rest follow.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: Planners pick the caterer who looks made for their event.

pins.area: The bio is written in decorative italic and typewriter unicode letters
pins.what: The bio is set in decorative unicode letters.
pins.why: Fancy letters read as a party flyer and make the same line harder to read and to find.
pins.how: Use plain text and let photos carry the mood.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Searches and quick readers miss the one line meant to explain you.

sections.intro: You told us people do not get Essence fast enough, and a new website did not change that. Here is why.
